projects.title: Optimus AI Assistant
projects.short_description: A modular voice- and text-controlled AI desktop assistant featuring six specialized agents, local intent routing with ModernBERT (Laya), cloud-based LLM generation, persistent vector memory, browser automation, and automatic model failover.
projects.detailed_description:
Optimus is a modular AI desktop assistant designed to combine intelligent task orchestration with fast, practical system automation. Built with LangGraph, it coordinates six specialized agents for conversational AI, browser automation, code assistance, reminders, memory retrieval, and visual understanding.
Its hybrid architecture uses Laya, a locally running ModernBERT-based intent-routing model, to handle intent classification and route tasks to the appropriate agent, while Groq-hosted LLMs handle open-ended generation. Automatic model failover helps the system recover when the primary LLM is unavailable.
Optimus also integrates persistent semantic memory using ChromaDB, LlamaIndex, and sentence-transformers, with asynchronous memory commits to avoid blocking response execution. Browser automation and desktop integrations enable it to perform tasks beyond ordinary conversational interactions.
The project includes benchmark tests covering five end-to-end workflows, with measured execution times of approximately 0.7–1.2 seconds per command in a single Windows test run. It also passed five tested failure-recovery scenarios without a process crash, including a simulated LLM outage.
Optimus explores a practical approach to agentic AI by combining local decision-making, cloud-based intelligence, persistent memory, and specialized tool execution in one extensible desktop assistant.

projects.title: Adiyogi Wellness
projects.short_description: An AI-powered full-stack wellness platform featuring multilingual conversational chat, avatar/audio interaction, weekly AI-generated insights, and hybrid database integration using React and Django.
projects.detailed_description:
AdiYogi Wellness is an AI-integrated full-stack wellness application designed to provide an intelligent and interactive user experience. Beyond traditional wellness tracking, the platform includes a multilingual AI chat assistant, avatar-based audio interaction, and AI-generated weekly insights to enhance user engagement.

The system implements secure authentication (signup/login), user profile management, and persistent conversational storage. It features a hybrid database architecture using SQLite for authentication and MongoDB for storing chat logs, insights, and application data.

The frontend is built using React with TypeScript and communicates with a Django REST backend through structured API endpoints. The platform demonstrates real-world full-stack development, AI integration, multilingual processing, voice interaction handling, and modular backend architecture.

The repository includes complete setup instructions for running both frontend and backend locally, along with environment-based configuration support.

Backend: Python, Django

Database: MongoDB / SQL 

Dev Tools: Node.js, Docker (optional)

projects.title: Financial Assistant Bot
projects.short_description: A Streamlit-powered financial chatbot that uses LLMs and real-time data tools to answer stock market and finance questions, providing stock prices, company information, trends, and business news.
projects.detailed_description: This project builds an interactive financial assistant chatbot application using Streamlit as the frontend interface and large language models (LLMs) for reasoning. It leverages tools like Yahoo Finance for live market data and DuckDuckGoSearchAPIWrapper for web search capabilities. LangGraph and LangChain integrations are used to intelligently decide when to invoke specific tools such as fetching stock prices or searching the web. Users can interact with the bot to get real-time stock quotes (e.g., NASDAQ, S&P 500, NIFTY, SENSEX), business news, market trends, and company details.

projects.title: Flower Image Generator using DCGAN
projects.short_description: A deep learning project that uses a Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Network (DCGAN) to generate synthetic flower images.
projects.detailed_description: This project implements a DCGAN using PyTorch to generate realistic flower images. It trains a generative model on the Oxford 102 Flower Dataset (over 8,000 images) to learn floral patterns and produce synthetic images. The model includes a Generator and Discriminator trained iteratively, with added features like CPU-optimization and intermediate image saving.

projects.title: Museum Ticket Booking Assistant
projects.short_description: An AI-powered museum ticket booking system with a multilingual chatbot assistant, built using Django, MongoDB, Streamlit, and LangGraph.
projects.detailed_description: This project implements a full-stack ticket booking assistant for museums and events. Users can register/login, browse museums and events stored in a MongoDB database, and book tickets. Bookings generate unique QR-code e-tickets, and a Streamlit-embedded chatbot powered by LangGraph and Azure OpenAI supports English, Hindi, and Gujarati interactions to help users explore events, book tickets, or fetch their bookings. Admins can manage users, events, and availability using Django’s admin panel.
